title: SPARC VORTEX vs NFW: analysis code and results
description: Reproducible analysis comparing a vortex-based dark matter halo profile against the standard NFW profile on 171 SPARC galaxies. Key results: VORTEX success rate 83.0% vs NFW 57.9% (chi2/dof < 3); median chi2/dof 1.11 vs 2.40; aggregate BIC difference Delta BIC = +5904 in favour of VORTEX, with 95% bootstrap CI [+3135, +9397] and P(Delta BIC > 0) = 1.0000; head-to-head BIC wins 141/171.
references: Lelli F., McGaugh S. S., Schombert J. M., 2016, AJ, 152, 157
McGaugh S. S., Lelli F., Schombert J. M., 2016, PRL, 117, 201101
Navarro J. F., Frenk C. S., White S. D. M., 1996, ApJ, 462, 563
